name: Desk Guard
author: buildwithnoknok
description: A little alarm for your desk, bag or room. A PIR motion sensor watches the room and an accelerometer feels a bump on the desk. Arm it with the LED Button, leave during the exit delay; movement starts an entry delay, then a siren. Third-party boards (Soldered PIR easyC, MSA311): plug them in with the brain off. A toy for peace of mind, not a security system.
assembly_guide: Unplug the PicoHub first: third-party boards are connected with the brain off.
Connect the Buzzer, the LED Button, the Soldered PIR (address 0x30, its default) and the MSA311 accelerometer to the PicoHub.
Fix the MSA311 to the desk or bag you want to guard. Plug in the PicoHub and run setup in the noknok app.

controls.action: Arm: exit delay with quiet beeps, then armed (faint red glow)
Entry delay: fast beeps and a flashing button - press the button to disarm
Siren for a while, then armed again

controls.control: Hold a button or the knob while plugging in
controls.action: Factory reset - keep holding until the LEDs flash / the buzzer confirms (about 8 s)

config_schema.label: Bump limit (m/s²)
config_schema.help: 1.0 = a knock on the table, 3.0 = a real shove
